fix_suggestions.primary_color_out_of_tolerance:
Role 'primary' expected {expected} (ΔE ≤ {threshold}). Found {actual} (ΔE {delta_e}).
Re-bind this layer to the 'primary' token for the active mode, or pull the
swatch from the Adobe Express brand library.
fix_suggestions.accent_color_out_of_tolerance:
Role 'accent' expected {expected} (ΔE ≤ {threshold}). Found {actual}.
Accent is for the DATA INSIGHTS label and donut stat only.
fix_suggestions.unauthorized_font_family:
Font '{actual}' is not permitted. Allowed: {allowed_families}.
Reset the text layer to the brand primary font.
fix_suggestions.typography_style_mismatch:
Style '{actual}' not allowed for node '{node}'. Allowed styles: {allowed_styles}.
Expected style for this node: {expected_style}.
fix_suggestions.type_overlap:
Text layer '{node}' overlaps another text layer. Type must NEVER overlap —
move or resize the layers so their bounding boxes don't intersect.
fix_suggestions.logo_clearspace_violation: Logo clearspace must be ≥ {multiplier}× the logo height on all sides.
